more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Azodicarbonamide is a defined organic compound used as a flour-ageing and dough-conditioning agent. FDA describes use in cereal flour and bread baking. The permitted concentration is no more than 45 parts per million relative to the flour. This is a manufacturing use limit, with separate restrictions imposed by the applicable food standards.
more_info.uses: Used for flour ageing and dough conditioning in cereal flour and bread baking. The US maximum is 45 parts per million relative to flour, subject to applicable food standards.
